injections: one or four exact ordinary selected native P1 ancestors
audited no-grad H0 cache per ancestor
explicit caller-bound CPU initialization seed per body
model_forward: model(route_rng_context=None,return_details=False); caller context(view) owns persistent body/view dropout streams; TRAIN4 draws per body; eval draws none
cache_helper: cache_stem(torch,F,ancestor,x,adjacency,degrees):exact undropped source clip-then-ReLU cache,no acquisition or fit
objective: model.objective(complete4TRAINlogits,callerTRAINids,callerTRAINy):mean4 own CE plus one frozen native first-layer penalty; no optimizer/role/horizon policy
eval_assembly: assemble_eval(torch,core):require all own models eval,complete raw logits plus mean softmax; no independent training/selector API
native_source: Require native-core P1 explicitly; no silent raw-author wrapper construction,factor conversion or alternate primitive
T_order: C(ReLU(Z@W+b)); bank retains both ReLU and clipped T outputs
private_coordinates: 32 route-specific registered e coordinates only in private4/middle; absent original mixed/I4/head-only

initialization.generator: One isolated CPU Generator per body from required caller seed,no invented seed offsets
initialization.law: Tensor.uniform_ with sqrt(6/(fan_in+fan_out)),same row-vector matrix storage as formula
initialization.head_only: Accept caller seed metadata but consume no initialization draws
initialization.bias_coordinates: Same fixed onehot(row)-.25 rows as candidate;row mean starts exactly zero;no extra RNG draws

live_autograd: First bank/gate once; private4 block2 per private state; middle block2 once from differentiable first-state mean; no detach/current-step cache; every forward resets from H0
independent: Four disjoint complete own mixed or bias-coordinate-single bodies; same read-only ancestors may be reused across reference families with acquisition charged once,never shared trainable model/history or coupled selector
checkpoint_inputs: H0/A/degree nonpersistent immutable buffers; caller must bind them in future checkpoint custody; source/native and memory parameters remain in state_dict
readout: .25 residual,clip,H0; shared zeroWo; no extra mixture clip/activation or intermediate dropout

gradient_delay.update1: Wo=0 on incoming forward, so every upstream continuation/T/e/gate CE gradient is zero; Wo and native head may receive CE gradients
gradient_delay.update2: Wo may be nonzero; continuation T maps/private e/final gate G2 and beta2 may receive CE gradients; both first gate G1 and beta1 remain CE-gradient-zero because their incoming G2 is still zero
gradient_delay.update3: after final G2 may have changed at update2, first gate G1 and beta1 can ordinarily receive CE gradients
gradient_delay.scope: ordinary nondegenerate reachability; no promise that each coordinate/group is nonzero at its first possible step; no memory regularizer added
gradient_delay.controls: Same zero-Wo/zero-final-gate ordinary CE delay applies to original and bias-coordinate singles/I4 as well as candidate/middle; e rows in bias control are common-bias coordinates only
gradient_delay.future_qualification: must account for staged gradient path; do not reject by requiring every gate map gradient at update2; no new qualification fixture or numerical operation authorized/performed

redundant_bias_coordinates: 32 extra learned e coordinates per bias_coordinate_single body,shape[2,4,4]; only mean of four rows enters each block gate; no private route contrasts or extra states
bias_coordinate_single: Same capable mixed single,one evolving state per block,gate=original common gate+mean(e[block],rows),four TRAIN tail draws/one eval prediction
I4_bias_coordinate: Four separately acquired/fitted/selected complete bias-coordinate singles,own source/caches/maps/gates/e/Wo/head/optimizer/RNG/stop;16 TRAIN tail draws/four eval predictions
